MetaMask is a non-custodial crypto wallet. MetaMask operates as a browser extension and as a mobile app. MetaMask supports Ethereum and other EVM-compatible networks. MetaMask gives users a gateway to decentralized applications.

Ledger Nano S Plus is a hardware wallet. Ledger Nano S Plus stores private keys offline on a dedicated device. Ledger Nano S Plus connects to a computer through USB. Ledger Nano S Plus supports a large number of cryptocurrencies.

Exodus Wallet is a multi-asset cryptocurrency wallet. Exodus Wallet is available as a desktop application and as a mobile application. Exodus Wallet is non-custodial, so users control their own keys. Exodus Wallet includes a built-in exchange feature.

bZx is a decentralized finance protocol for lending and margin trading. bZx runs on the Ethereum blockchain through smart contracts. bZx operates without a central intermediary. bZx is governed by holders of its governance token.
